title: The Bell of the Damned
description: A colossal dark cathedral looms under a stormy sky as a giant decaying hand holds a massive bronze bell above a circular stone arena. In the foreground, a figure in a black and white patterned robe and wide-brimmed hat stands beside a large black bull, surrounded by robed cultists holding candles while ghostly white figures and thick smoke swirl across the ritual ground.
prompt: A towering gothic cathedral with glowing rose windows stands in a dark stormy night. A giant rotting hand holds an enormous bronze bell high above a circular ritual arena filled with thick smoke. In the center, a robed figure wearing a black and white patterned cloak and wide hat stands beside a large black bull. Surrounding them are rows of hooded cultists holding candles, with ethereal white ghostly figures swirling at their feet, dramatic cinematic lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere.
